verdict.rationale: First-party docs show each Bot runs on a persistent cloud computer with a browser. The live Agent Computer preview shows its clicks, typing and navigation, and it can use browser-based services without a dedicated connector. Browser sessions persist across tasks, and the Bot hands control back to you for passwords, CAPTCHAs and payment confirmations. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of browser operation specifically, and detailed docs on web-research workflows (only use-case examples exist).

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites

citations.quote: Your Bots run on a persistent cloud computer with a browser, filesystem, and terminal
The preview shows clicks, typing, navigation, and current status.
Grok Bot can use many browser-based tools, including services without a dedicated connector.
A named Bot keeps its memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across sessions
